svg.title: Labeled street grid beneath a geohash boundary
svg.desc: A reduced San Francisco street map retains varied house footprints, neighborhood parks, principal streets, the original four-by-four boundary grid, and map attribution. Black street names with two-pixel white halos are painted above the road geometry and remain inside the map frame.
svg.metadata: Simplified street geometry derived from OpenStreetMap contributors; street names and layout follow boundary-issue.png.

g.text: Map tiles by Stamen Design, under CC BY 3.0. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
